name: Panda Video
description: Video hosting: upload, organize and configure videos, analytics, AI subtitles and Shorts.
author: com.pandavideo
readme: # Panda Video MCP server Connect [Panda Video](https://www.pandavideo.com) to Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor and any other MCP client. Upload, organize and configure your videos, read their analytics, generate subtitles and Shorts — from the conversation. The server is **hosted by us**: there is nothing to install and no code in this repository. Point your client at the URL below and sign in with your Panda Video account. ``` https://mcp.pandavideo.com/mcp ``` ## What you can do with it | Area | Examples | | --- | --- | | Videos | List and search videos, read one video, rename it, import a video from a URL | | Folders and playlists | Create folders, move videos, build playlists | | Analytics | Views, retention curve, top videos, account totals | | Subtitles and thumbnails | Read subtitles, generate them with AI, add thumbnails | | Player | Read and change the player and per-video configuration | | Shorts | Import a video and list the Shorts cut from it | Video listings already carry the public embed URL (`video_player`) and the HLS URL (`video_hls`), so the assistant can hand you a link that plays. Tools that change or remove something are marked `destructiveHint: true`, so your assistant asks before running them. Read-only tools are marked `readOnlyHint: true`. ### Two endpoints | Endpoint | Tools | For | | --- | --- | --- | | `https://mcp.pandavideo.com/mcp` | Full catalogue (177 tools) | Power users, Claude Code, Cursor, scripts | | `https://mcp.pandavideo.com/mcp/directory` | 29 core tools: videos, folders, playlists, analytics, subtitles, thumbnails, player, Shorts | Chat assistants (ChatGPT, Claude) | The directory endpoint leaves out credits, billing, users and sub-accounts. ## Connecting ### Claude Settings → Connectors → **Add custom connector**, and paste: ``` https://mcp.pandavideo.com/mcp/directory ``` Claude opens the Panda Video sign-in page, you approve the access, and the tools appear in the conversation. No API key to copy. ### ChatGPT Settings → Apps & Connectors → **Create** (Developer Mode), same URL and **OAuth** as the authentication. Same sign-in flow. ### Claude Code ```bash claude mcp add --transport http panda-video https://mcp.pandavideo.com/mcp \ --header "Authorization: panda-YOUR_API_KEY" ``` ### Cursor `~/.cursor/mcp.json`: ```json { "mcpServers": { "panda-video": { "url": "https://mcp.pandavideo.com/mcp", "headers": { "Authorization": "panda-YOUR_API_KEY" } } } } ``` ### Anything else The server speaks **Streamable HTTP** (stateless) at `/mcp` and `/mcp/directory`. Two ways to authenticate: **OAuth 2.1** — recommended, and what the chat clients above use. Discovery follows the specs, so a compliant client needs nothing but the URL: | Document | URL | | --- | --- | | Protected resource metadata (RFC 9728) | `https://mcp.pandavideo.com/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource` | | Authorization server metadata (RFC 8414) | `https://mcp.pandavideo.com/.well-known/oauth-authorization-server` | Dynamic client registration (RFC 7591) and PKCE with `S256` are supported, with public clients (`token_endpoint_auth_method: none`). Scopes are `videos:read` (read-only tools) and `videos:write`. **API key** — for scripts and local clients. Copy it in the Panda Video dashboard under **Settings → Advanced → API Key** and send it as is in the `Authorization` header. Treat it like a password: ```bash curl -X POST https://mcp.pandavideo.com/mcp \ -H "Authorization: panda-YOUR_API_KEY" \ -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ -H "Accept: application/json, text/event-stream" \ -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"tools/call","params":{"name":"panda_list_videos","arguments":{"limit":5}}}' ``` `initialize` and `tools/list` answer without credentials, so a directory can read the catalogue before anyone signs in. Every call that touches your account requires authentication; without it the server answers `401` with a `WWW-Authenticate` header pointing to the OAuth metadata. Requests are limited to 60 per minute per account. ## Accounts You need a Panda Video account. See [pandavideo.com](https://www.pandavideo.com) for the plans. ## Policies and support - Privacy: - Terms: - Help center: - API reference: - Something wrong with this server: open an issue here ## Why this repository has no code Directories ask for a repository URL, and this is it. The server runs on our infrastructure, so listing it does not require shipping the implementation — what a client needs is the URL above and the discovery documents, both public. This repository holds the registry descriptor (`server.json`), the logos and these instructions. Panda Video is a product of PANDA VIDEOS LTDA.
